GCC FULL BUILD
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude -c src/re3_codec.c -o re3_codec.o
ar rcs libre3_codec.a re3_codec.o
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_info.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_info
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_viewer.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_viewer
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_parts.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_parts
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tools/re3emd_morph.c libre3_codec.a -o re3emd_morph
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_synthetic.c libre3_codec.a -o test_synthetic
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_tim.c libre3_codec.a -o test_tim
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_key_resolution.c libre3_codec.a -o test_key_resolution
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude tests/test_texture_binding.c libre3_codec.a -o test_texture_binding

MAKE TEST
./test_synthetic
PASS synthetic RE3 core primitives
./test_tim
PASS synthetic PSX TIM

BASIC EXAMPLE BUILD
cc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -Iinclude examples/basic.c libre3_codec.a -o basic_example
